name: Ranking debate characters, voices and performances

prompt.value:
A photograph captured as a single frame from a video actually shot on an iPhone, with the texture of real iPhone footage. The image looks real, without an oily, overprocessed finish. The background is clearly visible, with no depth-of-field blur. Skin texture is natural and fine, and the lighting is natural. The image is coherent and free of visual artifacts.

A Chinese girl of 27, strikingly beautiful with the quick, self-possessed presence of a sharp technology critic. A precise black bob frames her face; cobalt blue tailoring over a black top, small silver earrings, very broad shoulders and excellent head-to-shoulder proportions. Her expression is alert, amused and ready to challenge a bad claim.

Vertical waist-up creator-video framing. She sits behind one side of a compact studio desk, face straight toward the lens with no head tilt, one free hand resting mid-gesture. Keep her eyes, hands and shoulders clear and leave useful room on the upper right for later graphics.

A warm, lived-in retro technology studio with amber practical lights, brushed metal, cream acoustic panels, a few translucent orange objects and a small plant. No readable signs, logos, captions or UI text.

The background is clearly visible, with no depth-of-field blur. Skin texture is natural and fine, and the lighting is natural. The image is coherent and free of visual artifacts.

A Chinese boy of 32, strikingly handsome with relaxed dry humor and the approachable confidence of a thoughtful creator. Soft wavy dark hair, an amber overshirt over a cream knit, strong natural facial structure and excellent head-to-shoulder proportions. He looks skeptical but entertained, as if he expects the other person to prove the point.

Vertical waist-up creator-video framing. He sits behind the opposite side of a compact studio desk, face straight toward the lens with no head tilt, shoulders relaxed and one hand ready for a small dismissive beat. Keep his face and hands clear and leave useful room on the upper left for later graphics.

The same kind of warm, lived-in retro technology studio: amber practical lights, brushed metal, cream acoustic panels, translucent orange details and a small plant, seen from the reverse side of the desk. No readable signs, logos, captions or UI text.

Nimble and playful, like a sharp friend impatient to skip the hype and test the real thing. Her phrasing is quick but articulate, with an audible smile and pointed emphasis on the verdict.

prompt.value:
Create a realistic vertical phone-shot talking-head video. @image1 is the visible speaker and scene reference. Preserve the person's identity, face, outfit, setting, lighting, lens feel, and broad composition. @audio1 is the speaker's voice-timbre reference.

Deliver the supplied script exactly in order with clear lip-sync. The visible person speaks every line. Do not rewrite, summarize, add, remove, or reorder words.

COMPOSITION: keep the speaker in the same general region and preserve the reference composition, allowing natural posture changes and tiny crop or scale breathing.

CAMERA: use one subtle push-in on the most important phrase, then return smoothly to the original framing.

EDIT RHYTHM: polished pause-trim jump cuts at phrase boundaries while keeping the framing coherent.

PERFORMANCE: playful, responsive delivery with teasing inflection, lively timing, and an audible smile. Let her impatience with empty hype come through in the voice and matching visible reactions.

GESTURE: compact explanatory hand movement close to the torso and inside the frame.

Keep face, hands, skin texture, lighting, and motion photoreal and stable. Add no subtitles, captions, labels, logos, UI text, floating words, or other readable on-screen text.

今天别聊谁最会营销，直接把 AI 视频能力排个级。

PERFORMANCE AND ACTION DIRECTION:
She dismisses the hype with a tiny sideways hand beat, leans in on 直接, and lands 排个级 with a quick challenging nod.
